# Kasane

> A design system for websites and web apps: surfaces are layered to separate content, and the accent colour is chosen from 9 palettes. 面を重ねて区切り、アクセントの色を9色から選べるデザインシステム。

Before building UI, read one of the specs below to the end. The English edition uses fewer tokens; both say the same thing.

- [Kasane v2 spec (English)](https://kasane.y-n0.de/v2/kasane.en.md): rules, tokens, HTML for every component, end-of-work checklist
- [Kasane v2 仕様書(日本語)](https://kasane.y-n0.de/v2/kasane.md): 同じ内容の日本語版
- [kasane.css](https://kasane.y-n0.de/v2/kasane.css): all tokens and component CSS
- [tokens.json](https://kasane.y-n0.de/v2/tokens.json): token values (W3C Design Tokens format)
- [kasane.js](https://kasane.y-n0.de/v2/kasane.js): optional script for the menu, dialogs, tabs, toasts and the palette
- [kasane-react](https://kasane.y-n0.de/v2/kasane-react-2.0.0.tgz) / [kasane-vue](https://kasane.y-n0.de/v2/kasane-vue-2.0.0.tgz): the components for React and Vue (npm install the URL); see section 16 of the spec
- [Source](https://github.com/yamamotoxqx/design-system-kasane): GitHub repository (MIT License)
